result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane urban street with commercial land use and signalized control. While sidewalks and crosswalks are present, the long crossing distance and lack of pedestrian refuge or curb extensions increase exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Scale Lighting
hazards.description: Lighting is provided by high-mast cobra heads intended for the roadway, which may leave sidewalks and crossing areas under-illuminated for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
